_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Purchase Order (PO) Index Amendments Report
summary: The Purchase Order (PO) Index/Amendments Report gives the Government purchase order data for Allowable Parts List items to monitor procurement of Contractor Furnished Equipment requiring repair parts support and allowance list development.
use_relationship:
The Purchase Order (PO) Index/Amendments Report provides the Government with purchase orders for all Allowable Parts List (APL) items to effectively monitor procurement of Contractor Furnished Equipment (CFE) requiring repair parts support and allowance list development.
This data item description (DID) contains the format and content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The PO Index Amendments Report shall be in the Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The PO Index Amendments Report shall contain the following:

children.title: PO Index Amendments.
children.content: The Index/Amendments shall be in alphanumeric sequence and shall include the following information:

children.title: Identification of all PO line items, by noun description and equipment functional description (EFD)
Contractor's design code designation, drawing number, and piece number
Vendor's Name and Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE)
Provisioning and technical documentation control number for all line items requiring repair and replacement parts
